author: NorthEast News Desk
body: The New England Revolution continue their road swing Wednesday night with an 8 p.m. Eastern match against New York City FC at Citi Field.

It is New England’s third consecutive away game and the second meeting between the clubs in three weeks. The Revolution entered the day fourth in the Eastern Conference and had won two of their previous three road matches, according to the club’s match preview.

New England is trying to rebound from a 2-1 loss at the LA Galaxy in which Carles Gil converted a late penalty and the Revolution struck the woodwork three times. The quick turnaround gives the club another chance to turn improved road performances into points before returning home.

The team’s official match guide carries the latest broadcast, radio and lineup information. Kickoff details can change because of weather or league operations, so supporters traveling to Queens or planning to watch should confirm the schedule close to game time. Final lineups and availability will be released nearer kickoff.
dek: New England enters an 8 p.m. match at Citi Field seeking points in its third consecutive road game.
headline: Revolution continue road swing against New York City FC Wednesday night
